name: text-ai
title: Text AI
description: Translate and polish the selected text in place using an LLM API.
author: zacharyzhuo

commands.name: translate
commands.title: Translate Selection
commands.subtitle: Text AI
commands.description: Translate the selected text and show the result for review before pasting.

commands.name: polish
commands.title: Polish English Selection
commands.subtitle: Text AI
commands.description: Fix the grammar of the selected English text and show the result for review before pasting.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Stored in the macOS Keychain by Raycast. Anthropic keys start with sk-ant-, Gemini keys with AIza.

preferences.name: workspaceId
preferences.title: Workspace ID
preferences.description: Anthropic only, and only for a multi-workspace personal or service account key. Value looks like wrkspc_01Jw... Find it at platform.claude.com/settings/workspaces. Leave empty for a single-workspace key or for Gemini.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Anthropic: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 (cheap) or claude-sonnet-5 (better Chinese). Gemini: gemini-2.5-flash.
